# `aitbc transactions estimate-fee`

Estimate the transaction fee for a transfer. The node has no fee-estimation endpoint (the old ``/rpc/estimateFee`` call always 404'd and fell back here), so the estimate is the flat default fee applied to every transfer.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc transactions estimate-fee [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--from` | text | — | yes | From wallet name |
| `--to` | text | — | yes | To address |
| `--amount` | decimal | — | yes | Amount to send |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc transactions estimate-fee --from <from_wallet> --to <to_address> --amount <amount>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc transactions estimate-fee --from <from_wallet> --to <to_address> --amount <amount> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
